properties.text: On May 25th, 2026, the six-year anniversary of the lynching of George Floyd, @daughtersandsonsofboriken, @wethepeople_nyc, @stopyourliesnyt, @palawdali and @rellyrebel rallied from Union Square park to Washington Square Park and the 79th Precinct in Bedford-Stuyvesant to honor George Floyd, protest brutal attacks against our communities, the continued continued attacks on Black and Brown men like Congolese-born man, Yves Sakila, 35, who was killed this week by private security guards in what Dubliners are calling “a George Floyd moment.” This is still happening!
